item.title: The Secret to Real Confidence After 60? Trust Your Feelings
item.description: For much of my life, I believed confidence meant keeping my emotions in check. Stay calm. Don't let them see you sweat. Push through. Many women of our generation were taught this early on. We learned to be capable, composed, and reliable – often at the expense of our inner lives...

item.title: 10 Great Ideas for the Winter Season
item.description: Living in areas with four seasons is a blessing. When I moved back to the four-season climate and winter came around, I was getting seasonal depression...

item.description: This is the most painful and raw story I have written to date – across all my blogs, interviews, and essays. Not because it is dramatic, but because it is vulnerable and honest. Some truths, once fully seen, can no longer be avoided...

item.title: Should I Retire Yet? The Emotional Readiness Checklist No One Gives You
item.description: You can be financially ready for retirement – and still feel completely unsure about whether it’s time. Anne appeared on my Zoom screen looking tense and tired. Before we even got into the details, she said, “I feel like I’m on a ledge.”

item.title: Poem: Fake Mike, Part 1 — Breaking Hearts and Into Bank Accounts
item.description: The lonely heart is a hungry old hunter, It wanders at night and it wonders and wonders. For years we were married, then suddenly—poof! A spouse disappears—by divorce… or by death. You planned a whole lifetime with someone beside you, Then life changed its mind and politely denied you.

item.title: The Surprising Reason You Might Get Sick More Often
item.description: If you catch every bug going around, your gut might be trying to tell you something. You might think of your digestive system as the system your body uses to process food. But did you know that about 70-80% of your immune system cells are located in and around your gut?
